newsitem.title: CHINA: Dazhong Taxi plans to buy tyre plant.
newsitem.headline: Dazhong Taxi plans to buy tyre plant.

text.p: The board of directors of Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co Ltd have proposed buying a bankrupt state firm, Shanghai Tyre Repair Plant, pending the approval of shareholders, a statement by the board said on Friday.
The board proposed to buy the assets of the plant for 20.26 million yuan, of which 20.08 million yuan will be used to deal with the bankrupt plant's workers, the statement said.
The plant was declared bankrupt in October last year by a Shanghai court, the statement said.

The company will buy the plant through the Shanghai Enterprise Exchange and an agreement signed on the exchange on Thursday said Dazhong Taxi would not be responsible for the debt the plant owned before being declared bankrupt, it said.
